Agentic pentesting: the hard part was never the AI.

It's the gates:
• Scope — stop where you're told
• Evidence — no finding without a repro trace
• Report — a human signs first

AI proposes. Real tools validate. Humans decide.

What's your 4th gate? github.com/BugTraceAI
